_comment: Copy to devices.json. One entry per physical screen. Editing this file changes what a screen shows on its next 30s poll, with no firmware involvement.

_notes.key: 32 hex chars. This is the only credential the screen has, so generate it randomly: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(16).toString('hex'))"
_notes.stale_after_s: How old a beat may be before the screen goes red. Match your agent's cadence: an always-on process might be 120, something on a 4-hourly cron needs 16200 or it reads red permanently.
_notes.lines: [label, field] or [label, field, true] for optional. Optional lines vanish when the field is absent instead of showing --. Five lines fit on a 240x320 panel.
_notes.rule: Every line must be actionable. Cut anything that makes you feel something but do nothing - uptime percentage and running totals are the usual offenders.
